operating_point.note: combustion.json v1 max-thrust point (O/F 7.76); the v2 grain runs O/F ~10.5 at max with the nominal law (inside the regression band 7-15): the plume CFD stays at the v1 point (see 05-plume-cfd/REPORT.md)

exhaust.model: calorically perfect ideal gas calibrated on CEA (shifting) so that pe/pc at eps 2 matches CEA
exhaust.transport_note: CEA frozen chamber values (thermal_bc_max_v1.csv header); irrelevant for the inviscid case, negligible against turbulent transport in the plume
exhaust.T0_note: delivered stagnation temperature eta_c*^2 Tc with eta_c* 0.92 (Tc CEA 3361 K)

mixture.reactions: none (frozen): afterburning is a post-processed fast-chemistry estimate in the own solver

inlet.direction: own solver: flow angle varies linearly from 0 on the axis to -45 deg (convergent wall angle) at the wall; Fluent: normal-to-boundary is acceptable (difference confined to the convergent)
